title: Serbia
capsule: From 1 December 1918 Serbia's Karađorđević crown merged into the new Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes (renamed Yugoslavia in 1929), with Serbia continuing thereafter as the union's largest constituent territory rather than a separate sovereign state. Reconstituted as a republic within Tito's socialist federation after 1945 and then within the rump Federal Republic of Yugoslavia after 1992, Serbia endured the Yugoslav wars, NATO's 1999 bombing campaign over Kosovo, and Kosovo's 2008 declaration of independence, which Belgrade has never recognized. Since Montenegro's 2006 referendum dissolved their federal union, Serbia has existed as a fully independent republic, pursuing European Union membership under a semi-presidential system centered on Belgrade.
